inline_hook_commands.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | xargs -I {} sh -c 'echo "{}" | grep -qE "\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$" && npx prettier --write "{}" 2>/dev/null || true'

jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | head -1 | grep -qE 'rm\s+-rf\s+/\s*$|rm\s+-rf\s+/\*|git\s+push\s+.*--force([^-]|$).*(main|master)' && echo 'BLOCKED: destructive command detected (--force-with-lease is allowed)' >&2 && exit 2 || exit 0

jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | head -1 | grep -qE 'rm\s+-rf\s+/\s*$|rm\s+-rf\s+/\*|git\s+push\s+.*--force.*(main|master)' && echo 'BLOCKED: destructive command detected' >&2 && exit 2 || exit 0
echo '[superclaude] Teammate idle — assign next task'
